title: XO, S-1, Echo and Foxtrot changes

paragraphs.text: Maj R. A. Pape relieved Maj T. E. Bulger as executive officer; Bulger transferred out. 1stLt D. R. West relieved 1stLt T. Boyd as S-1. 1stLt D. E. Marcum relieved 1stLt T. R. Minor as Echo commander; Minor transferred out. Capt R. A. Hickethier relieved 1stLt G. S. Burgett as Foxtrot commander.
